name: US Census Bureau
description: Discover Census datasets, variables and geography codes, then retrieve published estimates, margins of error and counts with source annotations.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Retrieve estimates. Input: dataset path (acs/acs5, acs/acs1, acs/acs5/subject, acs/acs5/profile, dec/pl, dec/dhc, pep/population, cbp ...), vintage, 1-200 variable names or group(TABLE) tokens, and a geography as Data API for/in predicates (for: 'county:*', in: ['state:06']). Returns one row per geography with values as published, sentinels turned into null plus annotation, FIPS parts, variable metadata with units, and the equivalent api.census.gov URL. Unknown variables are rejected with invalid_input naming them.

options.name: predicates
options.about: Exact-match filters on any returned column, e.g. {"NAICS2017": "00", "EMPSZES": "001"} for CBP or {"DATE_CODE": "12"} for PEP.

options.name: variables
options.about: Variable names (B01003_001E, B19013_001M, P1_001N, ESTAB) or group(TABLE). NAME and GEO_ID may be added to any request. Variables may span up to 8 tables; more than 50 variables are split into per-table fetches and merged by GEO_ID (reported in warnings).

response.about: Retrieve estimates. Input: dataset path (acs/acs5, acs/acs1, acs/acs5/subject, acs/acs5/profile, dec/pl, dec/dhc, pep/population, cbp ...), vintage, 1-200 variable names or group(TABLE) tokens, and a geography as Data API for/in predicates (for: 'county:*', in: ['state:06']). Returns one row per geography with values as published, sentinels turned into null plus annotation, FIPS parts, variable metadata with units, and the equivalent api.census.gov URL. Unknown variables are rejected with invalid_input naming them.

fields.name: complete
fields.about: Whether this response fully satisfied the request (not whether all pages were consumed). false when a supplementary source (metadata, geography levels) failed or when results were truncated.

fields.name: next_cursor
fields.about: Opaque cursor for the next page; null at the end. Offsets strictly increase, so a cursor can never loop. Maximum depth 1,000,000 records.

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.about: RFC 3339 UTC time of this call.

fields.name: source_updated_at
fields.about: Catalog `modified` timestamp of the dataset (published without a zone, labelled Z as given); null when the source does not publish one.

fields.name: source_urls
fields.about: Equivalent api.census.gov queries, one per table/geography fetch.

fields.name: total
fields.about: Rows after predicates, across all pages.

fields.name: variables
fields.about: Metadata for every returned variable in `values` order: label, concept, predicate_type, group, unit (from label), scale (null), attributes.

tools.name: Datasets
tools.description: Search the Census Data API catalog. Input: free-text query over dataset path, title and description plus an optional vintage (year). Returns one record per dataset/vintage with its API endpoint, metadata links, publication date and supported geography levels.

options.name: query
options.about: Case-insensitive tokens all of which must appear in the dataset path, title or description. Required (>= 2 characters) when vintage is null.

options.name: vintage
options.about: Restrict to one vintage year (reads api.census.gov/data/{vintage}.json, ~0.5 s). Null searches the whole catalog (~5 MB, 5-10 s).

records.description: The American Community Survey (ACS) is an ongoing survey that provides data every year -- giving communities the current information they need to plan investments and services. The ACS covers a broad range of topics about social, economic, demographic, and housing characteristics of the U.S. population. Summary files include the following geographies: nation, all states (including DC and Puerto Rico), all metropolitan areas, all congressional districts, all counties, all places, and all tracts and block groups. Summary files contain the most detailed cross-tabulations, many of which are published down to block groups. The data are population and housing counts. There are over 64,000 variables in this dataset.

tools.name: Variables
tools.description: List variables of one dataset vintage. Input: dataset path and vintage, plus a group (table id such as B01003 or DP05) and/or a free-text query matched against group descriptions and variable labels. Returns variable name, verbatim label, concept, predicate type, group and the unit phrase the label carries.

options.name: dataset
options.about: Data API dataset path, e.g. acs/acs5, acs/acs5/profile, dec/pl, cbp. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_/]+$.

options.name: group
options.about: Table id, e.g. B01003, S0101, DP05, P1. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,40}$.

options.name: query
options.about: Tokens matched against group name/description (when no group is given; the first 5 matching groups are listed) or variable name/label/concept (within a group). Datasets with at most 5 tables (cbp, pep/population) whose descriptions do not match are searched by variable label instead.

response.about: List variables of one dataset vintage. Input: dataset path and vintage, plus a group (table id such as B01003 or DP05) and/or a free-text query matched against group descriptions and variable labels. Returns variable name, verbatim label, concept, predicate type, group and the unit phrase the label carries.
